model.name: flood_unet
model.task: 3-class SAR change detection: 0 no water, 1 permanent water, 2 new flood water
model.input: 7 channels: post VV, post VH, pre VV, pre VH (dB, scaled), smoothed change VV/VH, slope; see floodsys/flood/model.py
model.training_data: Kuro Siwo GRD (Bountos et al., NeurIPS 2024, CC BY)
model.limitations: Trained mostly on low-relief floods; debris flows are not a label class; unseen terrain may degrade.
model.caveat: 19 of 25 test-shard events also occur in the training patches; only the unseen_events results are event-held-out.
